thread:
mira: Hey @support — customer bumped into rerank endpoint returning all zeros after copying the console cURL. Error shows 200 but scores are 0.0 for all items. Repro steps below.

devon: Can you paste the cURL you used?

mira: From console copy-paste:
```
curl 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{
  \"query\": \"best commit message examples\",
  \"candidate_documents\": ['\"doc1\",\"doc2\"']
}'
```
mira: On bash this sends fine, but customer on Windows cmd got `Invalid JSON` or got successful response with scores 0.0.

sam: Looks like the console example outputs single quotes and an inner array with quoted CSV style. Windows `cmd.exe` and some copy buffers change quoting. Also `candidate_documents` should be an array of strings not a single string.

irina: Example from docs should be:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\"
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\"
  -d '{\"query\":\"best commit message examples\",\"candidate_documents\":[\"doc1\",\"doc2\"]}'
```

mira: Customer also hit a 413 once when they had ~1200 candidate docs. Reranker limit in docs says max 1000 but console didn't enforce UI warning.

devon: Can you attach the raw request log (cURL on Windows)? Need to see Content-Type and payload bytes. @jesse any chance this is the JSON parser returning zeros when docs are flattened?

jesse: We had a bug where if candidates array is parsed as single string we cast to string and scoring falls back to uniform 0.0. Patch queued in PR #2043. Will release today. Also adding stricter 400 with message \"candidate_documents must be string[]\".

mira: Great — for now, ask customers to use the explicit JSON array format or use the SDK. Quick repro for Windows powershell:
```
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank\" 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $env:TOKEN\" 
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" 
  -d '{\"query\":\"q\",\"candidate_documents\":[\"a\",\"b\"]}'
```

mira: Filing docs issue: DOCS-321 Console copy button currently outputs single-quoted payload that breaks on cmd/powershell and also prints array as CSV string. @product please update.

sam: @product acked, I'll add a console test to ensure copy button produces valid JSON for bash/cmd/powershell. Also we'll add UI warning for >1000 candidates.

mira: Customer followed workaround and got correct rerank scores. Closing on customer side.
